name: Mighty Arp
author: Nick Culbertson
tagline: An FM synth with a chance arpeggiator and a step sequencer, for generative playing
description: Mighty Arp is a 4-op FM and subtractive hybrid synth built around a chance arpeggiator. You choose the notes, the arp decides when they play. Hold a chord, set CHANCE, and let it create melodies. Plus it has a 32-step sequencer, 50 sounds and a RANDOM kind that makes up new ones, chords with strum, swing and humanize, a chorus, a ping-pong delay and a reverb with shimmer, 16 presets of your own, and MIDI and clock over USB.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp
